summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the 4 new features. All flows work end-to-end. (1) /ask-team as manager: header + stats subtitle 'N threads · N waiting · N calls · N days' renders correctly, rep chips + LAST 7/14/30 chips render, days switch reloads overview + updates subtitle, prior session auto-loads, new-chat resets to 6 starters, ask flow returns AI answer within ~15s with citation chips (ask-cite-P1/P2/P3 'Open thread' + ask-cite-C2/C3 'Call'), 3 clean follow-ups (no em dashes, no bracket markers), tap on ask-cite-P1 navigates to /thread/{conv_id}. team-ask-history shows sessions. (2) Manager Hub: Manage section shows 'Ask Jessi About The Team' tile -> /ask-team; sparkles icon (inbox-ask-team-btn) shown on Team Inbox segment -> /ask-team; NOT shown on My Inbox. (3) RBAC: rep on /ask-team sees team-ask-forbidden 'Managers only' (backend returns 403 detail 'Manager or admin role required'); rep Manage section does NOT show tile; rep inbox shows no sparkles btn. (4) Draft From Answer (rep, Sarah Tester): ask-draft-text btn shows 'Turn this into a text', clicking triggers 'Writing your text…' spinner then ask-draft-preview appears with editable ask-draft-text-input containing 'Just confirming for tomorrow at 5:30, will you be coming in with your husband, or is it just you?' — no em dash, no [C1@..] markers. Button label read 'Copy to a new thread' (Sarah has no text thread with rep), tap shows toast (per spec acceptable). (5) Record Anything: record-conversation-btn pill renders next to Ask/Search/Call/Voice Memo; tap opens record-chooser modal; Cancel closes it; Start actually gained mic permission in headless (unexpected but no crash — red recording banner 'Recording conversation with Lead · 0:03' shown). (6) Inbound email: after inserting an inbound email via ingest_received_email fixture into a TEST_iter_email conv for Sarah Tester, the thread page renders the bubble 'Saturday at 10 works!' with a purple 'Replied via email · Re: Saturday' badge — visually correct but the badge's data-testid does not forward to DOM (see minor). (7) Regression: /thread/{id}?prefill=hello%20from%20test correctly prefills composer with 'hello from test'. Per-contact Ask sheet still returns clean citations and follow-ups (regression pass). Cleanup: TEST_iter_email conversation + messages + events + notifications deleted.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='message-email-reply-badge' is passed as a raw prop on a React Native <View>, which does not forward to the DOM in RN Web. The badge renders correctly visually but cannot be located by [data-testid=...] selectors. Use dataSet={{ testid: 'message-email-reply-badge' }} pattern (same as thread-ask-jessi-btn / team-ask-* / ask-* elements).

team-ask-history + team-ask-session-{id} entries visible after a session exists

action_items: Optional testability fix: switch data-testid on MessageBubble email-reply badge to dataSet={{ testid: 'message-email-reply-badge' }} so automation can locate it (visual behavior already correct).
critical_code_review_comments: ask-team.tsx line 137/146: message_count/2|0 uses bitwise OR floor — cosmetic, prefer Math.floor.
ask-team.tsx onCite 'call' branch: same api.defaults.baseURL concern as AskJessiSheet — hard-codes baseURL in audio URL; verify runtime baseURL when call has_recording is true.
MessageBubble.tsx line 241 uses raw data-testid= prop on <View> — RN Web ignores it. Follow the tid() helper pattern used elsewhere (dataSet.testid).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for scoped features (7 flows verified end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: created 1 conversation (6aa4dd631d584bb390402b8d) for Sarah Tester + inbound email message via ingest_received_email; ALL cleaned up after test (messages/conversation/contact_events/notifications). Ask sessions accumulated on qa-manager and activation-tester as normal side effect of ~2 LLM asks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four new features work end-to-end from the web preview. Only remaining nit is the message-email-reply-badge data-testid not forwarding on RN Web (badge itself renders visually). Note the record-conversation-btn actually started recording in headless Chromium (mic permission was granted by default in this preview) — spec expected denial, but the flow still handled it gracefully with no crash and the red recording-banner + Stop & save button appeared. About 3 LLM asks used this iteration.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — no functional issues found. The one minor UI-testability nit (email badge testid) is caused by React Native Web dropping unknown props on <View>; standard fix is dataSet.testid, same pattern used by thread-ask-jessi-btn, ask-* and team-ask-* elements.
